pages.title: Chapter Overview
pages.text: Secure a sect quota, enter the timed Blood Forbidden Land, and return with Foundation resources.$(br2)This chapter contains 2 authored quest lines. The index describes routes and does not replace server progress.

pages.title: Blood Forbidden Land Trial
pages.text: Gather medicine, judge rivals, and escape before the secret-realm window closes.

pages.title: Ink Jiao Pool Event (Optional)
pages.text: A jiao waits underwater and another disciple waits ashore; hunt, help, or leave.
